text: Caller: Good morning Mr. Iyer, this is Priya from your bank's customer service. You had requested a callback about your debit card replacement.
You: Yes, I did. My card was damaged.
Caller: Your new card has been dispatched and will arrive in five to seven working days. For your safety, we will never ask for your PIN or OTP on a call. Is there anything else I can help you with?
You: No, that's all. Thank you.
Caller: You're welcome. Have a nice day.
